system.alertContribution: +2 per round while active (it is loud)
system.senses: Smells a spider automatically at Alert 2+; doesn't need line of sight.
system.passive: Not malicious. Wants to play. Equally threatening.
system.escalation: At Alert 4 it barks. When it barks, the Alert immediately rises by 2.
system.weakness: Treats, another animal to fixate on, going outside (needs a door opened, which is a whole thing).
system.notes: Note: the dog will try to carry crew members gently in its mouth. Acrobatics (Difficulty 4) to escape. It thinks it's helping.
system.biography:
“It Wants to Be Friends. That's Worse.”

Not malicious — it just wants to play, which is exactly as threatening. Loud, fast, and completely convinced it is helping.
